paite: Huchi in Kiriath-jearim a mite ahohsuk ua, TOUPA bawm alatou ua; mual a Abinadab inn ah alalut ua, atapa Eleazar TOUPA bawm kemtu in aseptuam uhi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Kiriath-jearim Ah
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took Yahweh’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep Yahweh’s ark.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Kiriath- jearim a bawm a-om sung sawtpi, kum sawmnihtak ahi. Huchi in Israel inkuan tengteng in TOUPA alungzuan nawnta uhi.
heading: Samuel In Israel Tung Ah Vai Ahawm
english: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long—for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel lamented after Yahweh.

paite: Samuel in Israel inkuan tengteng kiang ah, "Na lungtang tengteng uh toh TOUPA lam hong nga na hih taktak uleh, gamdang pathiante leh Ashtaroth na lak ua kipan koihmang unla, na lungtang uh TOUPA a ding in kisakholsak un. Amah kia nna sem un; huchi in Philistia mite khut a pan nou ahon tankhe ding hi," chi in agen hi.
english: Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to Yahweh with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to Yahweh, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”

paite: Huchi in Israel mite'n Baal leh Ashtaroth akoihmang ua, TOUPA nna kia asemta uhi.
english: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served Yahweh only.

paite: Samuel in, "Israel mi tengteng Mizpah ah samkhawm vek unla, TOUPA kiang ah ka hon thumsak ding," achi hi.
english: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to Yahweh for you.”

paite: Huchi in Mizpah ah apaikhawm ua, tui atawi ua, TOUPA ma ah asungbua uh. Huai ni in an angawl ua, huai ah TOUPA tung ah i na khialta uh, achi uhi. Samuel in Mizpah ah Israel mite vai ahawmsak hi.
english: They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before Yahweh, and fasted on that day, and said there, “We have sinned against Yahweh.” Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah.

paite: Philistia mite'n Israel mite Mizpah ah a-omkhawm uh chih azak un, Israel mite sual ding in Philistia hausate akisatou ua, Israel mite'n huai ana zak un Philistia mite alauta uhi.
english: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. When the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.

paite: Huchi in Israel mite'n Samuel kiang ah, "Philistia mite khut a pan hon hondam dia TOUPA i Pathian na hon sapsak tawp ke'n," achi uh.
english: The children of Israel said to Samuel, “Don’t stop crying to Yahweh our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.”

paite: Samuel in belamnou nawi ne lai ala a, halmang thillat in TOUPA kiang ah alan hi. Israel mite a ding in Samuel in TOUPA asam a, TOUPA'N adawng hi.
english: Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt offering to Yahweh. Samuel cried to Yahweh for Israel, and Yahweh answered him.

paite: Samuel in halmang thillat alat laitak in Philistia mite'n Israel mite sual ding in ahon naih uhi. Himahleh huai ni in TOUPA'N Philistia mite tung ah ngaihtak in van agingsak a, abuaisakgawp a, Israel mite ma ah zoh in a-om uhi,
english: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines came near to battle against Israel; but Yahweh thundered with a great thunder on that day on the Philistines and confused them; and they were struck down before Israel.

paite: Mizpah a pan Israel mite apawt ua, Philistia mite adelh ua, Beth-kar nuai atun tan un athat zel uhi.
english: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them until they came under Beth Kar.

paite: Huchi in Samuel in suang ala a, Mizpah leh Shen kikal ah aphut a, "Hiai tan TOUPA'N hon panpih hi," chi in amin "Ebenezer" asa hi.
english: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us until now.”

paite: Huchi in Philistia mite azahlakta ua, Israel gam ah ahoh nawnta kei uh. Huchi in Samuel damsung tengteng TOUPA khut in Philistia mite adou hi.
english: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped coming within the border of Israel. Yahweh’s hand was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

paite: Philistia mite'n Israel mite khua alakte uh Ekron a pan Gath tan in Israel mite ape nawn vek uh. Agam Israel mite'n Philistia mite khut a pan atankheta uhi. Israel mite leh Amor mite kal ah kilemna a-om hi.
english: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines. There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

paite: Huchi in adamsung teng Samuel in Israelte vai ahawmsak hi.
english: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

paite: Kum teng in Bethel leh Gilgal leh Mizpah aveh zel a; huai mun teng ah Israelte vai ahawmsak hi.
english: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.

paite: A-inn omna ahih ziak in Ramah ah apai nawn zelzel hi. Huai ah Israel mite vai ahawmsak hi. Huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam khat adoh hi.
english: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there, and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to Yahweh there.
